# hi-data-model-discovery: hướng dẫn

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-wiki-pages.mjs from SKILL.md; edit the skill, then re-run -->

> Sinh draft mô hình dữ liệu logic và vật lý, ERD, từ điển dữ liệu, ownership, vòng đời, độ nhạy cảm và khoảng trống migration.

**Mô tả gốc (EN):** Produce draft-only evidence-backed physical and logical data models, ERDs, entity and field inventories, data dictionaries, ownership, read/write access, lifecycle, sensitivity, caching, replication, and migration gaps. Do not execute schema migrations or present inferred relationships as declared constraints.

## Cách gọi

```text
/hi-data-model-discovery <database | module | entity scope> — draft-only
```

## Ranh giới

- Do not execute schema migrations or present inferred relationships as declared constraints.
- An inferred foreign key, cardinality, owner, or retention policy never becomes a declared constraint.
